#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> pq;
    int e = 0, o = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        int ele = arr[i];
        if (ele % 2 == 0) e++;
        else o++;
        if (e == o) {
            pq.push(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    while (B >= 0 && !pq.empty()) {
        B -= pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (B < 0) break;
        ans++;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
